cases.disposition_reason: Compare levels reached no color at 120 by 40 after 256 colors and 16 colors. The settled 80 by 24 frame still showed no color, and that narrow frame was captured before the terminal grew back. Turning Compare levels off restored truecolor. The five options stayed at running, on, 2000, off, and on.
cases.action_sequence: Turn Compare levels on, scroll the bands, narrow the terminal, then turn Compare levels off.
cases.expected_results: Colour bands for the supported levels are visible, and the page state is unchanged after return.
cases.forbidden_effects: Leaving Compare levels changes the selected page or an option value.

cases.disposition_reason: activity.state=stopped finishes inside start as stopped · exit 143 · descendants reaped, with steps 5 of 5 and Exit 143. activity.state=failed finishes inside start as failed · exit 1, with error: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use :::8080 and api exited with code 1. Neither launch shows Restarted api dev. The baseline is the stopped playground.
cases.combination_reason: Execute the default and one non-default boundary. Execute another option in combination only when needs declares a dependency. Unrelated options do not form a Cartesian product.
cases.action_sequence: Set activity.state from its default to another listed value through --opt or the Options control.
cases.expected_results: The visible Run state effect matches the selected value.

cases.disposition_reason: With motion paused, the running frame is captured before Stop. Stop shows Stopping api dev…, stopping · SIGTERM sent, and stop requested by holla · SIGTERM to the process group, with steps 3 of 5. Restart while stopping leaves that frame. Restart from activity.state=stopped shows Restarted api dev.
cases.action_sequence: With motion paused, capture the running playground, click Stop and capture the stopping frame before it finishes, then click Restart. On a separate activity.state=stopped launch, click Restart.
cases.expected_results: Stop shows Stopping api dev…, stopping · SIGTERM sent, and stop requested by holla · SIGTERM to the process group, with steps 3 of 5. Restart while stopping leaves that frame. Restart from the finished stopped option shows Restarted api dev and running · 12 min 42 s.
cases.forbidden_effects: The stopping frame shows api dev stopped · exit 143 or stopped · exit 143. Restart while stopping starts a new run.
